import numpy as np, mujoco
from rcb_hb import Session
# Parameters are physical joint angles and feedback gains.
DEFAULT=np.array([.8,.65,.23,.45,0.,0., .8,.12,.4,.06, .6,.10,.15,.04, .04,.0,.10, .0,.0,.0, .0,.0, .4,.0, .5, .0])
SCALE=np.array([.20,.20,.16,.25,.10,.08, .6,.20,.40,.15, .6,.20,.25,.15, .10,.12,.15, .25,.15,.15, .20,.15, .4,.20, .5, .30])
class Runner:
 def __init__(self):
  self.s=Session('walk',instance='/app/instance.npz');self.m=self.s.model;self.d=self.s.data
  self.lo,self.hi=self.m.actuator_ctrlrange.T;self.torso=mujoco.mj_name2id(self.m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY,'torso_link');self.head=mujoco.mj_name2id(self.m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,'head')
 def run(self,p,n=1000,record=False):
  self.s.reset();d=self.d;m=self.m;acts=[];metrics=[];total=0
  period=np.clip(p[0],.35,1.8)
  for i in range(n):
   t=i*.02;phase=2*np.pi*t/period+p[25];ramp=min(1,t/max(.15,p[24]))
   R=d.xmat[self.torso].reshape(3,3);pitch=np.arctan2(R[0,2],R[2,2]);roll=np.arctan2(-R[1,2],R[2,2]);yaw=np.arctan2(R[1,0],R[0,0])
   vx,vy,vz=d.sensordata[:3] # identify below
   # global root velocity is adequate for the feedback controller
   vx,vy=d.qvel[:2];wx,wy,wz=d.qvel[3:6]
   q=np.zeros(19)
   for side,off in [(1,0),(-1,5)]:
    ph=phase+(0 if side==1 else np.pi);sw=max(0,-np.cos(ph));wave=np.sin(ph)
    knee=p[1]+ramp*p[3]*sw
    hip=-.5*knee+ramp*p[2]*wave+p[4]
    ankle=-hip-knee+p[5]
    hip+=p[6]*pitch+p[7]*wy+p[8]*(vx-p[22])+p[9]*vz
    ankle+=p[10]*pitch+p[11]*wy+p[12]*(vx-p[22])+p[13]*vz
    q[off]=p[20]*yaw+p[21]*wz
    q[off+1]=side*p[14]+ramp*p[15]*np.sin(phase)+p[16]*roll+p[17]*wx+p[18]*vy
    q[off+2]=hip;q[off+3]=knee;q[off+4]=ankle+ramp*p[19]*wave
   q[11]=p[23]*np.sin(phase)*ramp;q[15]=-q[11]
   q[12]=.05;q[16]=-.05
   a=np.clip(2*(q-self.lo)/(self.hi-self.lo)-1,-1,1).astype(np.float32)
   if record:
    done=self.s.step(a)[2];acts.append(a)
   else:
    ctrl=self.s.low.task.unnormalize_action(a);d.ctrl[:]=ctrl;mujoco.mj_step(m,d,nstep=10);done=d.qpos[2]<.2
   height=d.site_xpos[self.head,2];upright=d.xmat[self.torso,8]
   vel=self.s.low.robot.center_of_mass_velocity()[0]
   stand=np.clip(1-max(0,1.65-height)/.4125,0,1);up=np.clip((upright-.1)/.8,0,1)
   effort=np.mean(np.minimum((d.actuator_force/100)**2,1))
   speed=np.clip(vel,0,1.1)/1.1
   score=stand*up*(.15+.85*speed)*(1-.15*effort)
   total+=score
   if record:metrics.append([vel,height,upright,effort,d.qpos[0],d.qpos[1],score])
   if done or height<.7:break
